summary: Add one optional, fail-closed advisory input to the existing reviewed Provider route. Revalidate the sealed brief, project only compact guidance into planning and each component, bind its hash to resume/checkpoint identity, and prove it on a deliberately small CLI child project.
provider_guidance: Build a compact Python CLI child project with direct ownership boundaries: one typed Note model, one atomic JSON repository, one NotesService, and one argparse CLI. Do not introduce a generic pipeline, stage framework, web surface, network access, database, or plugin system.

Implement exactly four user behaviors: add a non-empty note and return its stable ID; list notes in creation order; case-insensitive search over title and body; delete an existing note with a stable not-found error. Persist atomically using a temporary sibling file followed by replace.

Keep the implementation at no more than six primary source files and three behavior-grouped test files. Generate source in dependency order and reject any manifest that does not map all four commands to concrete callable handlers.

Use stable JSON output for successful and failed CLI operations, an explicit schema version in storage, and deterministic injectable clock/ID seams in tests. Corrupt storage must fail safely without overwriting the original file.

Validate syntax and imports before tests; then run substantive repository/service tests and a real CLI add-list-search-delete smoke flow in a temporary directory. Do not manually edit generated source to make the acceptance run pass.
acceptance_checks: The formal run artifact contains the exact validated CGKNCodexCapabilityBrief, while Provider component context contains only the bounded advisory projection and fixed NOT_EVALUATED authority.
Every planned component carries the same brief SHA-256, and changing that hash changes component checkpoint identity or fails resume before generation.
Generated pytest passes with host plugin autoload disabled and includes substantive add/list/search/delete, atomic persistence, not-found, and corrupt-storage assertions.
A clean real CLI flow adds two notes, lists them in order, searches case-insensitively, deletes one, and returns a stable not-found error on repeat deletion.
No Agent-authored generated source, alternate materializer, package shortcut, or delivery claim appears in the run.
tool_evidence_requests: Run the capability-supervisor, formal-route, and kernel contract tests including tamper and checkpoint-hash negative cases.
Inspect the formal run phase log and component pipeline to prove the existing Provider route consumed the brief.
Run the generated test suite and CLI smoke flow against a temporary data file, then inspect canonical result and delivery artifacts.
known_limits: One small project can prove wiring and a concrete behavioral result but cannot establish that Agent guidance improves every domain or large-project run.
The brief remains advisory and its own status is NOT_EVALUATED; only canonical generated-project evidence can support a formal result.
